subject: XRP spot repricing, perpetual leverage, issuer-derived ETF holdings changes, and XRPL lending-amendment governance

mission.foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification

capture.note: Public pages and the Kraken JSON endpoint were inspected during this run. Exact per-request retrieval timestamps and original HTTP wire bytes were not exposed by the retrieval interface. Provider publication/update times are kept separate from retrieval time. No synchronized point-in-time market cutoff is asserted.

limitations: Single venue only.
Top-of-book only; not full depth or executable size.
Ticker response does not expose a provider event timestamp in the captured response.
Aggregated publisher data is not independent of the underlying exchange feeds.
Liquidations are a lower bound because venues publish only part of their real-time liquidations.
Long/short ratio is account count, not notional exposure.
Vote counts are from the publisher's own-node validation stream, not an official XRPL Foundation publication.
The page contains multiple vintages: the 03:40 UTC roll call, a later current-ledger display, and a 01:00 UTC signed daily snapshot. These timestamps are not interchangeable.
Documents the protocol rule, not the current live vote count.
Daily flow is computed from changes in issuer-reported holdings, not direct AP cash creation/redemption reports.
GXRP flow is excluded because of an issuer-page capture gap; its holdings remain in totals.
XRPR includes some indirect XRP exposure through another XRP ETP.
BITW XRP sleeve can change through multi-asset index rebalancing.
The publisher counts excluded fund flows as zero in aggregate totals and treats changes under 100 XRP as rounding noise.
Some historical rows are reconstructed from third-party estimates between issuer-reported anchors.
Fee accruals paid in XRP and index rebalancing can appear as holdings-derived flow.
Only four funds are included in the daily series shown.
November 5 is partial at 2 of 4 funds.
Holdings-derived changes can include staking rewards, fees and other non-creation/redemption movements.
Underlying issuer files overlap with XRP Insights; the two aggregators are not independent primary sources.
Kraken top-of-book is not consolidated depth.
Best bid/ask sizes describe displayed top levels only.
Ticker last, bid/ask and 24-hour aggregates are not guaranteed to be sampled at one exchange event time.
Open interest is USD-notional and can fall with mark price even without equivalent position closure.
Liquidations are reported as a lower bound across five exchanges.
Account long/short ratio is not notional positioning.
Funding remains positive despite the long liquidation imbalance.

xrpl_amendments.official_rule: An amendment must maintain support from more than 80% of trusted validators for two weeks; if support falls to 80% or less, the two-week period restarts.
xrpl_amendments.interpretation: The observed SingleAssetVault and LendingProtocol votes remain below the 29-of-35 threshold. The dashboard reports no active 14-day activation countdown. These vote counts are a third-party own-node observation, not a primary XRPL Foundation publication.
xrpl_amendments.collateral_boundary: SingleAssetVault deposits are pooled funding assets, not evidence of borrower collateral. LendingProtocol design is uncollateralized and externally underwritten; amendment support is not proof of active loans, XRP collateral utilization, or XRP demand.

xrp_insights.methodology: Per-fund day-over-day issuer-reported holdings change; not direct AP cash flow.

cryptokeyhole.methodology: Per-fund holdings changes from issuer files; publisher notes staking rewards, fees and cash payouts can affect the changes.

aggregate_comparison.explanation: XRP Insights includes six spot funds plus BITW, while CryptoKeyhole's displayed daily series covers four funds. Both use overlapping issuer-reported holdings. A matched fund/date/source-vintage matrix is required before attributing the difference to genuine publisher error or market flow.
aggregate_comparison.cash_flow_interpretation: Neither aggregate is direct AP cash creation/redemption. Holdings changes may include index rebalancing, staking rewards, fees, indirect ETP exposure, excluded funds and provisional issuer data.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: The short-horizon repricing is materially associated with a leveraged-long unwind.
supporting_evidence: Seven-exchange USD open interest is down 6.69%.
Long liquidations are at least $14.48M versus $455,230 short liquidations.
Long accounts are 80.1% of its five-exchange sample.
disconfirming_evidence: OI is USD-notional and partly price-sensitive.
OI-weighted funding remains positive at +0.0060% per eight hours.
Account counts do not measure notional exposure.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: Issuer-reported ETF holdings reductions may represent a marginal source of XRP supply.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights reports -64,826 XRP for November 4 and -259,701 XRP over November 2–4.
disconfirming_evidence: CryptoKeyhole reports -3,339 XRP for November 4 across its four-fund universe and +1,837,670 XRP over its last five complete days.
Fund universes and data vintages differ.
Holdings changes are not direct AP cash flows and can include non-creation/redemption movements.
GXRP flows are excluded in XRP Insights while its holdings remain included.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: XRPL native lending may become a future institutional catalyst, but the observed governance state does not establish near-term activation.
supporting_evidence: LendingProtocol has 21 of 35 yes votes and SingleAssetVault 23 of 35, below the 29-vote threshold.
The dashboard reports no amendment in the 14-day activation countdown.
disconfirming_evidence: Validator votes can change at later flag ledgers.
Future activation would still not establish loan origination, XRP collateral usage or XRP market demand.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: Much of the ETF aggregate disagreement is explained by different fund coverage, source vintages and holdings-change methods.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights covers six spot funds plus BITW; CryptoKeyhole's daily table covers four funds.
Both publishers derive flows from issuer holdings and their underlying source families overlap.
The latest November 5 rows are provisional or partial.
disconfirming_evidence: A matched per-fund, same-date, same-issuer-file comparison has not yet been completed.
The 61,487 XRP November 4 difference remains numerically unreconciled.

red_team_objections: A falling USD open-interest total is not equivalent to an equal dollar amount of closed positions because price changes affect notional OI.
Positive funding and long-account skew remain contrary evidence to a clean completed long flush.
The Kraken quote is single-venue top-of-book and has no exact event timestamp.
ETF holdings deltas must not be relabeled as net AP cash or actual XRP purchases.
XRP Insights and CryptoKeyhole share issuer-level source data and are not independent primary sources.
XRPL vote counts are an independent node observer's report; the official XRPL documentation confirms the threshold but not these live counts.

reasons: No synchronized per-source retrieval timestamps or byte-complete raw HTTP receipts.
No common event-time cutoff across spot, derivatives, ETF and amendment observations.
ETF daily holdings changes are not direct AP cash flows and remain unreconciled by matched fund/date.
Third-party derivatives aggregation has incomplete venue-level liquidation coverage.
No independent evaluator-attested out-of-sample lift is demonstrated by this artifact.

forecast.reason: This artifact is a cross-source research reconciliation, not a validated point-in-time feature snapshot or out-of-sample evaluation. No directional XRP forecast is supported.

next_tests: Capture synchronized exchange-native spot trades and L2 order-book snapshots with exact retrieval time, event time, raw response bytes and SHA-256 receipts.
Build a matched issuer/fund/date ETF holdings matrix for XRPC, XRP, XRPR, XRPZ, GXRP, TOXR and BITW; preserve indirect exposure and excluded/reconstructed rows.
Reconcile the next XRPL flag-ledger vote and the complete 14-day majority history from ledger evidence.
Separate USD-notional OI changes into price effect and contract-position changes using exchange-native contract units.
Keep this artifact outside the model feature store until raw-source receipts and point-in-time validation pass.
